product.title: Slim Commuter Backpack in Jet Black

description.plain:
<p><meta charset="utf-8"><meta charset="utf-8">The Signature Commuter Backpack is a work bag worth showing up with. Polished, water-repellent nylon meets smart organization for your laptop, water bottle, keys, and whatever the day has in store. Looks sharp in the meeting. Works even harder getting you there.</p>
<p><meta charset="utf-8"><em>* Signature Bag Tag included in purchase. Personalization available for US only. Charms and keychains sold separately. </em></p>Personal Item, 16" laptop pocket, 2 water bottle pocketsMaterial Nylon, recycled leather trim, metal hardware
Dimensions 11.8" x 5.9" x 16.5"
Weight 2.3 lbs
Capacity 15 LCrafted with durable water-repellent nylon, leather trim, and metal hardware
Padded exterior-access laptop pocket fits devices up to 16"
Expandable exterior water bottle pocket fits bottles up to 32 oz
Zippered front slip pocket keeps quick-grab essentials within reach
Large interior slip pocket for documents and larger essentials
Interior mesh slip pockets keep smaller items organized and easy to find
Interior zip pocket keeps valuables secure
Elastic key clip keeps keys easy to find
Padded, adjustable shoulder straps for comfortable carrying
Trolley sleeve secures to any Away suitcase for a smooth ride
D-ring with removable personalization tag to attach charmsWe want you to love getting Away, which is why we offer free returns and exchanges on unused items within 100 days. You can test your purchase at home, but it must remain unused to be eligible. Learn more.
Our bags and accessories are all protected by a limited one-year warranty, which includes coverage for functional damage due to manufacturing defects or unexpected rough travel. Learn more.
